en-US.author: Learning Machines LLC
en-US.description: The IDE for interactive AI image and video creation, with visual crafting tools for precise, repeatable results.
en-US.longDescription:
ArtCraft is the IDE for interactive AI image and video creation. Compose in 2D, stage scenes in 3D, and choose the models that fit your work. Turn prompting into crafting with visual tools for precise, repeatable results.

Crafting features
- Image to Location: place virtual actors in a consistent environment and plan multiple shots in the same room.
- 3D and 2D image compositing: layer backdrops, foregrounds, props and image layers with background removal and drawing tools to build compositions with depth.
- Image to 3D Mesh: turn an image into a 3D object you can position, rotate and frame precisely.
- Character Posing and Character Identity Transfer: pose characters and set your camera before generating the final shot, using a posed mannequin to guide placement and pose.
- Scene Blocking with Kitbashing: combine 3D asset kits to control camera angles, object placement and depth.
- Mixed Asset Crafting: combine image cutouts, worlds and 3D meshes in one scene.

Quick and easy prompting
- Text to Image: explore ideas across a wide range of image models with a text prompt.
- Prompted Image Editing: describe changes to an image with models such as Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image.
- Canvas Image Editing: use drawing, masks and inpainting to guide exactly where an image changes.
- Image to Video: animate an image with your choice of video models and generation controls.
en-US.name: ArtCraft

zh-CN.description: 交互式 AI 图像与视频创作 IDE，提供可视化 craft 工具，实现精确、可复现的结果。
zh-CN.longDescription:
ArtCraft 是一款面向交互式 AI 图像与视频创作的 IDE。你可以在 2D 中构图、在 3D 中搭建场景，并选择适合自己作品的大模型。借助可视化 craft 工具，让提示词变成精确、可复现的创作。

Craft 功能
- Image to Location：将虚拟演员放置到一致的环境中，在同一房间里规划多个镜头。
- 3D 和 2D 图像合成：叠加背景、前景、道具和图像图层，配合背景移除与绘图工具，搭建有纵深的构图。
- Image to 3D Mesh：把图像变成可以精确摆放、旋转和取景的 3D 对象。
- 角色摆姿与角色身份迁移：在生成最终镜头之前，先用姿势人偶确定角色位置与姿态，并设定相机。
- Scene Blocking 与 Kitbashing：组合 3D 资产套件，控制相机角度、物体位置和景深。
- 混合资产创作：在一个场景中组合图像抠图、世界和 3D 网格。

快捷提示词
- 文生图：用文本提示词在众多图像模型之间探索创意。
- 提示词图像编辑：用 Nano Banana Pro、GPT Image 等模型描述对图像的修改。
- 画布图像编辑：通过绘制、蒙版和局部重绘精确控制图像变化的位置。
- 图生视频：用你选择的视频模型和生成控制参数让图像动起来。
